subject: How to change the number of iterations in INLA model fit

messages.author: 14ee5df6121f437e
messages.subject: How to change the number of iterations in INLA model fit
parts:
Hello all,

At first I want to know, when we fit BYM or any spatial model in INLA, what is the default number of iterations in INLA to obtain the result. For example, when I am fitting the model below:

formula<-y~ 1+f(ID,model="bym",graph=H_qld,scale.model = TRUE,
                hyper = list(prec.unstruct=list(prior="loggamma", param=c(1,0.001)),prec.spatial=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001))))
... ...

model.liver.qld<-inla(formula,family="poisson",
                  data= data.liver_qld_male ,E=E, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE))


And the second question is, can I change the number of iterations? if so how?

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to change the number of iterations in INLA model fit
parts:
It does however depend on the initial values and the integration strategy.

Are you asking because you want to speed up the model run?
- In this case you can take a look at the init and the int.strategy in
- https://haakonbakka.bitbucket.io/btopic107.html

Haakon
